caption: The drawing features a large, central depiction of the numbers "1687" rendered in a dark, iron-like color and ornate style, each digit formed with decorative flourishes including curled ends and pointed tips reminiscent of wrought iron. Above these numbers, there is a small, light brown line drawing of a building façade, showing a stepped gable roof, several windows with small arches, a central door, and some minimal detailing indicating architectural features, including a weather vane on top of the roof. Additionally, in the upper left corner of the drawing, there is an inset rectangular box containing a sketch of the number "1" in the same ornate style as in the main number sequence, highlighting its design with a spiral base and a fleur-de-lis top. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and the entire composition is surrounded by a thin, double-lined rectangular border. There is a handwritten name “Samuel Trosman” and a number at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Wrought Iron Numerals
